chunks: We have destroyed the likes of you; so is there any one who will be warned?

key_terms.مُذَكَّرٍ: One who is warned / One who takes heed

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'destroyed the likes of you' in Surah Al-Qamar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'ashya'akum' (your cousins/kinsmen) is often interpreted as referring to the disbelievers of the Prophet's own tribe, Quraysh, highlighting the severity of divine retribution even upon those closely related to the Messenger. This verse serves as a solemn warning to the contemporary audience of the Prophet, urging them to reflect on the fate of previous nations like 'Ad and Thamud as a precursor to their own potential destruction if they persist in denial.
